lessons.cause: A new domain, command or word landed without the repo-wide specs that list it: a context map relationship, the FrameworkBluebooks list, model_check findings, MCP argument names, CLI help snapshots and the Tickets bluebook spec.
lessons.check: Run the six named specs when a landing touches a bluebook, a hecksagon or a command.
lessons.fix: Declare the context map relationship, list the bluebook in the hecksagon reference, classify the new MCP argument names, and rewrite the CLI help snapshots by running spec/cli_help_snapshot_spec.rb with SNAPSHOT=rewrite after reading the diff, never by hand.

lessons.cause: A bluebook or command changed and the committed generated output (the reference docs and README indexes, and each domain's glossary) was not rewritten.
lessons.check: Run spec/reference_golden_spec.rb, spec/glossary_spec.rb and spec/adapters/driven/codebase_language_spec.rb when a bluebook or command changes.
lessons.fix: Rewrite the reference docs and README indexes with exe/hecks language_run.project_reference! --confirm --wait, and each domain's glossary/ with the glossary projection spec/glossary_spec.rb compares against (the introspection.glossary command); commit what they changed and never hand-edit the output. regeneration_run.regenerate_corpus! rewrites the Rust output only.

lessons.cause: A new DSL word has no coverage: an AdapterBuilder method is untested, the word has neither a corpus use nor a named exemption, or the Rust parser pair is not accounted for.
lessons.check: Run the three coverage specs when a DSL word is added.
lessons.fix: Add a DSL example, a named corpus exemption if the word has no corpus use, and the parser's coverage row. The stays_inside word (ADR 0171) is the worked case.

signature: Please tell me who you are
lessons.cause: A spec passes alone and fails in a CI shard: it assumes another spec loaded a constant, it clashes with a top-level constant, or a scratch git repository has no committer identity.
lessons.check: Run the new spec together with its neighbours in a clean detached worktree, the way the CI shards do.
lessons.fix: Require the constant the spec uses from its own file, and give every scratch git repository a local committer identity.

lessons.cause: A spec wrote to the owner's real state: a fixture red flag went into the primary checkout's git directory, or fake events went into the live event tap.
lessons.check: spec/support/live_state_guard.rb fails by name a spec that opens the live tap or moves the checkout's red flag.
lessons.fix: Build the flag and the tap in a temporary directory and name them in the example (checkout:, or an event_log path in a world).

lessons.cause: A timing budget failed on one slow runner, where the warm median sat just over its ceiling.
lessons.check: The timing budget spec in the test job.
lessons.fix: Rerun the one job first. Only a repeat over the ceiling is a real slowdown, and then find what got slower.

lessons.cause: A commit message carried a Claude attribution trailer, which the repository's rules forbid.
lessons.check: The MainIntegration saga's boarding refuses a range that carries an agent's attribution trailer, by name. SendTrain.board! does not check.
lessons.fix: Amend the commit message to remove the trailer line: no Co-Authored-By line and no Claude-Session line.
lessons.enforced_by: MainIntegration::RangeGuard refuses a range with an attribution trailer when the MainIntegration saga boards (ab08527fd). Not yet enforced on SendTrain.board!: lib/hecks/hecks/adapters/git_train.rb does not read commit messages. Follow-up: a trailer check on the SendTrain.board! path.

signature: a red run on a pushed range
lessons.cause: The push train pushes everything on local main, so a boarding carried commits that sat there unverified, with a revert on top of them.
lessons.check: Before boarding, local main is ahead of origin/main by exactly your commit, or its tree equals a green tree.
lessons.fix: Stop when local main holds other commits; let their coders board them, or revert only your own.
